scripts.text:
[Librarian]
What are you doing?
Don't touch anything!
scripts.translation:
[圖書管理員]
你在做什麼？
別亂碰東西！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I should read this
from the point where
I left off...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我應該從上次
讀到的地方繼續讀...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh...?
What's this mark
here at the bottom?
Some kind of secret?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦...？
這裡下面
有個標記？
某種秘密嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No wonder the librarian
seemed to hesitate before
saying anything. Huh.
Now let's see...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
難怪圖書管理員
說話時顯得猶豫不決。
嗯。
讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Personnel Record]
^663300Lowen, of the 2nd squad, returned to her detachment 3 days after the incident. A trial was held, and she was judged guilty of fleeing when ordered to fight.^000000
scripts.translation:
[人事檔案]
^663300第二小隊的洛溫，在事件發生3天后返回了駐地。經過審判，她被判定在接到戰鬥命令時臨陣脫逃，罪名成立。^000000

scripts.text:
[Personnel Record]
^663300Despite the severity of this offense, she was only discharged from the Crusaders and the holy power granted to her was forcibly removed...^000000
scripts.translation:
[人事檔案]
^663300儘管罪行嚴重，她僅被開除出十字軍，並被強行剝奪了神聖力量...^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
She was forced to leave the Crusaders?! That's ridiculous!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
她被強制開除出十字軍？！
這太荒謬了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did they want to sentence her to death or what? That's almost too cruel. She must have been humiliated...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
難道是想判她死刑嗎？
這也太殘忍了。她一定受到了很大的羞辱...

scripts.text:
[Personnel Record]
^6633002 years later after the incident, an expedition team found rusty armor shards, a broken sword
and some effects belonging to
Lowen Ellenen.^000000
scripts.translation:
[人事檔案]
^663300事件發生2年後，一支探險隊發現了鏽蝕的盔甲碎片、破裂之劍，以及屬於洛溫·艾萊南的一些物品。^000000

scripts.text:
[Personnel Record]
^663300However, this information
is highly classified. Officially, Lowen Ellenen died during the mission.^000000
scripts.translation:
[人事檔案]
^663300然而，這條資訊屬於高度機密。官方說法是，洛溫·艾萊南在任務中死亡。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
They thought she brought
disgrace to the Crusaders?
This sounds pretty messy.
Should I try to meet her again?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他們認為她給十字軍
帶來了恥辱？
這聽起來很混亂。
我應該再試著見她一次嗎？

scripts.text:
[Librarian]
^666666*Yawn...*^000000
What the...?
who are you!
Get the hell
out of here!

[Librarian]
^666666*Yawn...*^000000
What the...?
who are you!
Get the hell
out of here!
^3355FFYou took the book from the shelf while the librarian was dozing. According to the Crusader Personnel Records, there's only one recruit that was named Lowen Ellenen.
scripts.translation: ^3355FF趁圖書管理員打盹時，你從書架上拿走了那本書。根據十字軍人事檔案，只有一名名為洛溫·艾萊南的招募者。

2nd squad...
Age 22...
Female...

第二小隊成員...
年齡22歲...
女性...

information the
Librarian told me!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]

這和圖書管理員
告訴我的資訊不一樣！
